resolved_conflicts.explanation: Idaho Fire Lookouts names the Clearwater National Forest. Forest Lookouts ties the lookout to the Clearwater Timber Protective Association, which ran it in the 1915 to 1921 items. firelookout.com gives only the abbreviation CTPA. The record uses the Idaho name and the story notes both.

notes_for_editor: The 1914, 1934 and 1961 dates agree across firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts. Staffing differs by source: Idaho names Andrews for 1921, while the Forest Lookouts page quotes an August 1921 item naming R. M. Crow. The 1961 destruction has no stated cause in these pages. Forest Lookouts gives the location as 39N-7E-7; the brief coordinates (46.73426, -115.26762) come from the firelookout.org list and were not checked against a map. The USFS Clearwater lookout list PDF was read but has no Dead Horse entry in the cached text. A Facebook group post surfaced in search with similar dates and a different section number; it was not opened and is not cited. No photos added: none with a usable URL was read.
